errorCodes.meaning: The host does not know the named capability/version (not built in, and no manifest supplied).
The capability is already enabled for this community.
The supplied config does not validate against the capability manifest's configSchema.

CapabilityManifest.description: The self-description of a pluggable community capability: the Trust Task families it serves, the trust-registry vocabulary it reads and writes, the roles that may operate it, the membership lifecycle hooks it consumes, and the external adapters that act on its decisions. The manifest is what governance approves, what discovery advertises, and what a management UX renders.

configSchema.description: Spec slug of the JSON schema the per-community `config` document must validate against.

consentClass.description: Map of capability operation to the consent class its execution requires under the host's delegated-execution policy.

externalAdapters.description: Out-of-stack components that consume this capability's trust decisions.

ref.description: Where the adapter lives, e.g. a repository path or URL.

lifecycleHooks.description: Membership lifecycle events the capability consumes, e.g. `member.enrolled`, `member.revoked`, `role.changed`.

roles.description: Map of capability operation (e.g. `grant`, `view`) to the community roles allowed to perform it.

specs.description: Trust Task spec slugs (or `<family>/*` globs) this capability serves when enabled.

title.description: Human-readable capability name for management surfaces.

vocabulary.description: The trust-registry tuple vocabulary this capability may read and write. A conforming host MUST reject writes by this capability whose `action` is not listed.

actions.description: TRQP `action` values this capability owns, e.g. `git.commit.sign`.

resourcePattern.description: Human-readable pattern of the `resource` values used, e.g. `<org>[/<repo>]`.

CapabilityManifest.title: CapabilityManifest

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

enabled.description: True once the capability is active for the community.

enabledAt.description: When the enablement took effect, per the host clock.

schema.description: A community operator enables a pluggable capability for a community. Activation registers the capability's Trust Task handlers, advertises it in discovery, and starts its lifecycle hooks; a community with no enable record carries none of the capability's records, surfaces, or attack surface.

capability.description: Namespace slug of the capability to enable, e.g. `git-trust`.

config.description: Per-community configuration. Opaque to the framework; the recipient MUST validate it against the schema named by the capability manifest's `configSchema` and reject `configInvalid` on mismatch.

delegate.description: DID of the companion service that serves this capability, for capabilities not built into the host. When present, the host records a namespace delegation to this DID and `manifest` is REQUIRED (the host cannot know a companion's manifest a priori).

manifest.description: The capability's manifest. OPTIONAL for built-in capabilities (the host knows it); REQUIRED when `delegate` is present.
